title: Evaluation components with a fixed normalized total tensor comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme, U an open [def-pc-scheme], P,F integer cochain complexes of modules on the over-U site, L the functor of Modules.overEquiv U and T its degreewise functor. Let e be a natural termwise internal-Hom comparison and b(M) chain isomorphisms between T Hom(P,M) and Hom(TP,TM) satisfying the specified product projection equations [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections]. Let m be a symmetric core monoidal structure on L whose unit equals overEquivFunctorObjUnitIso U, and c an already fixed total tensor comparison for F and the ordinary dual of P satisfying all its summand equations [lem-pc-ordinary-evaluation-tensor-summands]. Let a be the canonical single-unit chain comparison and d=b(O[0]);Hom(TP,a). For every chain map f satisfying the local ordinary evaluation predicate [def-pc-ordinary-evaluation-data], the chain map (c;Tot(1 tensor d))^(-1);T(f);b(F) satisfies the scheme ordinary evaluation predicate [def-pc-scheme-ordinary-evaluation-formula]. This statement constructs neither the Hom comparison nor the monoidal structure nor c. No chain-map naturality of b, boundedness or perfectness is assumed.

proof.text: For each p,q,n,r use transport_summand_projection to move the tensor summand and Hom projection to the image of the local composite. Apply congrArg L.map to the local evaluation hypothesis and whisker the resulting equality by the two source arrows and output comparison. Compose with over_component_identity to identify it with the isolated scheme component. Apply schemeOrdinaryEvaluation_of_components.
